{{External|rs|rsc}} {{otheruses|def=no|shortbows in general|Shortbow (weapon)}} {{Infobox Item |name = Shortbow |image = [[File:Shortbow.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = Short but effective. |value = 50 |weight = 1.360 |respawn = 200 |exchange = Yes |id = 841 }} [[File:Shortbow detail.png|left|100px]] The '''shortbow''' is the weakest [[Shortbow (weapon)|bow]] in ''[[Old School RuneScape]]'' and can use arrows up to [[iron arrows|iron]]. Players can purchase this bow from [[Lowe's Archery Emporium]] in [[Varrock]]. Players are supplied with this bow along with several [[bronze arrows]] as their first [[ranged weapon]] on [[Tutorial Island]]. [[Members]] can make a shortbow through the [[Fletching]] skill at level 5. First, a player must cut an [[Shortbow (u)|unstrung shortbow]] from [[logs]], granting 5 Fletching [[experience]]. Then, the player must string the [[Shortbow (u)|unstrung shortbow]] with a [[bow string]], granting 5 experience. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = 0 |arange = +8 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = 2h |speed = 4 |attackrange = 7 |combatstyle = Bow |image = [[File:Shortbow equipped.png]] |altimage = [[File:Shortbow equipped female.png]] }} {{CombatStyles|Bow|speed=4|attackrange=7}} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Fletching |skill1lvl = 5 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 5 |members = Yes |ticks = 2 |mat1 = Shortbow (u) |mat2 = Bow string |output1 = Shortbow }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Shortbow}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Shortbow}} ===Item spawns=== {{ItemSpawnTableHead}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Shortbow|location=[[Kharidian Desert]] - north-west of the [[Uzer Hunter area]]|members=Yes|3389,3123|leagueRegion=desert}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Shortbow|location=[[Taverley]] - building directly west of the tree patch ({{FloorNumber|uk=1}})|members=Yes|plane=1 |2914,3439|leagueRegion=asgarnia}} {{ItemSpawnTableBottom}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 26 January 2005 |update = Slayer Skill |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 1 – 28 June 2004 |change = The item was recoloured. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Shortbow detail (historical, v1).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Shortbow detail (historical, v2).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Shortbow detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Shortbow (historical, v1).png|center]] |[[File:Shortbow (historical, v2).png|center]] |[[File:Shortbow.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 –
